title: Climate & Energy — GRI 302 and GRI 305 (2016 editions)
description: A focused subset of GRI energy and greenhouse gas disclosures for organizations that have identified climate change and energy as material topics. Designed for disclosure-readiness reviews of mid-sized companies.
effective_rule: Use for reports published before 1 January 2027. GRI 305 disclosures 305-1 to 305-5 are withdrawn when GRI 102: Climate Change 2025 takes effect, and GRI 302 is replaced by GRI 103: Energy 2025, both on 1 January 2027 (GRI, June 2025).

changes: 305-1: added element for biogenic CO2 emissions reported separately (305-1-c), previously omitted.

305-2: added conditional element for the market-based Scope 2 figure (305-2-b). It applies when the documents mention contractual instruments such as guarantees of origin, renewable energy certificates or power purchase agreements.
Initial curated subset covering GRI 302-1, 302-3, 302-4, 305-1 to 305-5 and GRI 2-5.

notes: Absence of evidence in the uploaded documents is not evidence of non-compliance. Applicability depends on the organization's material topics (GRI 3-3); reviewers can mark individual requirements as not applicable with a rationale.

requirements.title: Direct (Scope 1) GHG emissions
requirements.summary: Gross direct (Scope 1) greenhouse gas emissions in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent, together with the gases included, the base year where applicable, the source of emission factors and GWP rates, the consolidation approach, and the methodologies used.
requirements.applicability: Applies when climate change / emissions is a material topic (GRI 3-3).

elements.label: Gross Scope 1 emissions value (tCO2e)

action.title: Obtain the gross Scope 1 emissions figure
action.detail: Request the gross Scope 1 total in tCO2e for the reporting period, with the underlying activity data (fuel use, process data) and the calculation workbook.

elements.label: Reporting period stated with the figure

action.title: Confirm the period covered by the Scope 1 figure
action.detail: State the reporting period (start and end dates) alongside the Scope 1 value.

elements.label: Consolidation approach (operational control, financial control or equity share)

action.title: Confirm the consolidation approach used for GHG reporting
action.detail: Document whether emissions are consolidated using operational control, financial control or equity share, and confirm that the same boundary applies across scopes.

elements.label: Standards, methodologies or calculation tools used

action.title: Reference the calculation methodology
action.detail: Name the standard or methodology used (for example the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard) and any calculation tools.

elements.label: Greenhouse gases included in the calculation

action.title: List the greenhouse gases included
action.detail: State which gases (CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3) are included in the calculation.

elements.label: Source of emission factors and global warming potential (GWP) rates

action.title: Disclose emission factor and GWP sources
action.detail: Identify the source of emission factors (e.g. DEFRA/DESNZ, IEA, national inventories) and the GWP values used (e.g. IPCC AR6).

elements.label: Base year, where applicable

action.title: Document the base year and recalculation policy
action.detail: State the base year, the rationale for choosing it, base-year emissions, and the policy for recalculation.

elements.label: Biogenic CO2 emissions reported separately

action.title: Report biogenic CO2 emissions separately
action.detail: Quantify CO2 from the combustion or biodegradation of biomass (e.g. biomass fuels, alternative fuels) and report it separately from gross Scope 1, or state that none arise.

requirements.title: Energy indirect (Scope 2) GHG emissions
requirements.summary: Gross location-based energy indirect (Scope 2) GHG emissions in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent, the market-based figure if applicable, gases, base year, emission factor sources, consolidation approach and methodologies.
requirements.applicability: Applies when climate change / emissions is a material topic (GRI 3-3).

elements.label: Gross location-based Scope 2 emissions value (tCO2e)

action.title: Obtain the location-based Scope 2 emissions figure
action.detail: Request purchased electricity, heat and steam consumption by site and the grid emission factors applied, and calculate the location-based Scope 2 total.

elements.label: Reporting period stated with the figure

action.title: Confirm the period covered by the Scope 2 figure
action.detail: State the reporting period alongside the Scope 2 value.

elements.label: Consolidation approach (operational control, financial control or equity share)

action.title: Confirm the consolidation approach used for GHG reporting
action.detail: Document whether emissions are consolidated using operational control, financial control or equity share, and confirm that the same boundary applies across scopes.

elements.label: Standards, methodologies or calculation tools used

action.title: Reference the calculation methodology
action.detail: Name the standard or methodology used (for example the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard) and any calculation tools.

elements.label: Source of grid emission factors

action.title: Disclose the source of grid emission factors
action.detail: Identify the grid emission factors used (and residual-mix factors for market-based figures).

elements.label: Market-based Scope 2 figure (applies where contractual instruments are used)

action.title: Calculate the market-based Scope 2 figure
action.detail: The documents refer to contractual instruments for electricity. Calculate Scope 2 using the market-based method (supplier-specific or residual-mix factors) and report it alongside the location-based figure.

requirements.title: Other indirect (Scope 3) GHG emissions
requirements.summary: Gross other indirect (Scope 3) GHG emissions in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent, the Scope 3 categories and activities included, and the methodologies used.
requirements.applicability: Applies when value-chain emissions are relevant to the organization's climate impacts.

elements.label: Gross Scope 3 emissions value (tCO2e)

action.title: Quantify Scope 3 emissions for material categories
action.detail: Complete a Scope 3 screening, quantify the material categories (typically purchased goods and services, upstream transport, use and end-of-life of sold products), and report the gross total in tCO2e.

elements.label: Scope 3 categories and activities included

action.title: Identify the Scope 3 categories included
action.detail: List which of the 15 GHG Protocol Scope 3 categories are included and justify exclusions.

elements.label: Reporting period stated with the figure

action.title: Confirm the period covered by the Scope 3 figure
action.detail: State the reporting period alongside the Scope 3 value.

elements.label: Standards, methodologies or calculation tools used

action.title: Reference the calculation methodology
action.detail: Name the standard or methodology used (for example the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard) and any calculation tools.

requirements.title: GHG emissions intensity
requirements.summary: The GHG emissions intensity ratio, the organization-specific denominator chosen, the scopes included in the ratio, and the gases included.
requirements.applicability: Applies when climate change / emissions is a material topic (GRI 3-3).

elements.label: GHG emissions intensity ratio

action.title: Calculate and disclose a GHG intensity ratio
action.detail: Divide absolute emissions by an organization-specific metric (e.g. tonnes of product) and report the ratio.

elements.label: Organization-specific denominator

action.title: State the intensity denominator
action.detail: Name the organization-specific metric used as the denominator.

elements.label: Scopes included in the ratio

action.title: Specify which scopes the intensity covers
action.detail: State whether the ratio includes Scope 1, Scope 2 and/or Scope 3 emissions.

requirements.title: Reduction of GHG emissions
requirements.summary: GHG emissions reduced as a direct result of reduction initiatives, in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent, with the base year or baseline, the scopes in which reductions occurred, and the methodologies used.
requirements.applicability: Applies when the organization reports emissions-reduction initiatives.

elements.label: Emissions reduced through initiatives (tCO2e)

action.title: Quantify reductions achieved by initiatives
action.detail: Calculate emissions reduced as a direct result of each initiative (tCO2e), separately from changes in output.

elements.label: Base year or baseline for the reductions

action.title: Document the baseline for reductions
action.detail: State the base year or baseline used and the rationale for choosing it.

elements.label: Scopes in which reductions took place

action.title: Identify the scopes affected by reductions
action.detail: State whether reductions occurred in Scope 1, Scope 2 and/or Scope 3.

elements.label: Description of reduction initiatives

action.title: Describe the reduction initiatives
action.detail: Describe the initiatives (e.g. fuel switching, efficiency upgrades) that produced the reductions.

requirements.title: Energy consumption within the organization
requirements.summary: Total energy consumption within the organization, fuel consumption from non-renewable and renewable sources including fuel types, electricity, heating, cooling and steam consumption, the standards and methodologies used, and the source of conversion factors.
requirements.applicability: Applies when energy is a material topic (GRI 3-3).

elements.label: Total energy consumption within the organization

action.title: Obtain total energy consumption
action.detail: Compile fuel, electricity, heating, cooling and steam consumption by site and report the total in joules or watt-hours.

elements.label: Fuel consumption by source, including fuel types

action.title: Break down fuel consumption by source
action.detail: Report fuel consumption from non-renewable and renewable sources and list the fuel types used.

elements.label: Electricity consumption

action.title: Report electricity consumption
action.detail: Report electricity consumption (and heating, cooling and steam where relevant).

elements.label: Reporting period stated with the figure

action.title: Confirm the period covered by the energy figure
action.detail: State the reporting period alongside the total energy figure.

elements.label: Source of conversion factors

action.title: Disclose energy conversion factors
action.detail: Identify the source of the conversion factors (e.g. calorific values) used to express fuel use as energy.

requirements.title: Energy intensity
requirements.summary: The energy intensity ratio, the organization-specific denominator, the types of energy included, and whether the ratio uses energy consumed within the organization, outside it, or both.
requirements.applicability: Applies when energy is a material topic (GRI 3-3).

elements.label: Energy intensity ratio

action.title: Calculate and disclose an energy intensity ratio
action.detail: Divide energy consumption by an organization-specific metric (e.g. tonnes of product).

elements.label: Organization-specific denominator

action.title: State the energy intensity denominator
action.detail: Name the organization-specific metric used as the denominator.

elements.label: Energy types and organizational scope included

action.title: Clarify what the energy intensity covers
action.detail: State the energy types included and whether consumption outside the organization is included.

requirements.title: Reduction of energy consumption
requirements.summary: Reductions in energy consumption achieved as a direct result of conservation and efficiency initiatives, the types of energy included, the baseline, and the methodologies used.
requirements.applicability: Applies when the organization reports energy conservation initiatives.

elements.label: Energy reductions achieved through initiatives

action.title: Quantify energy savings from initiatives
action.detail: Quantify reductions achieved as a direct result of conservation and efficiency initiatives (MWh or GJ).

elements.label: Base year or baseline for the reductions

action.title: Document the baseline for energy savings
action.detail: State the base year or baseline used to calculate reductions.

elements.label: Types of energy included in the reductions

action.title: Specify the energy types reduced
action.detail: State whether savings relate to fuel, electricity, heating, cooling or steam.

requirements.title: External assurance
requirements.summary: The organization's policy and practice for seeking external assurance and, where the sustainability information has been assured, the assurance provider, the level and scope of assurance, and the standards used.
requirements.applicability: Universal disclosure under GRI 2: General Disclosures 2021.

elements.label: Statement of the external assurance position (assured, or explicitly not assured)

action.title: State the external assurance position
action.detail: Disclose whether the climate and energy data has been externally assured and, if not, the policy on assurance.

elements.label: Level and scope of assurance

action.title: Describe the scope of assurance
action.detail: Identify which indicators were assured and at what level (limited or reasonable).

elements.label: Assurance standard applied

action.title: Name the assurance standard
action.detail: Identify the assurance standard applied (e.g. ISAE 3000 / ISAE 3410).
